Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident pays a flat 20% income tax on salary and most other income (from 1 January 2023); royalties and property rent are taxed at 10%; there is no allowance and no regional layer.

sources.said: Starting from 1 January 2023, income tax should be calculated at a 20% flat rate.

Income from royalties is subject to 10% tax and interest (if not exempt) is subject to 20% tax starting from 1 January 2023. If paid by a tax agent (i.e. legal entity, individual entrepreneur), tax should be withheld at source. Income from lease of property is subject to 10% tax.

Article 150. Income tax rates 1. The income tax on royalties shall be calculated at a 10 percent rate. 7. The income tax on rentals shall be calculated at a 10 percent rate

figures.finding: A tax agent (company or entrepreneur) withholds income tax from every payment to an individual (a final monthly withholding at 20% on other income) and transfers it by the 20th of the following month; an invoiced payment to a registered entrepreneur is not withheld.

sources.said: Other income paid by a tax agent is subject to final withholding on a monthly basis. The taxable base is the gross income minus deductible income. Other income will be withheld at a flat rate of 20%.
Any income payment by a tax agent to an individual is subject to withholding unless the payment is to an individual entrepreneur and against appropriate invoices,
WHT from payments to individuals must be transferred to the State Budget not later than the 20th day of the following month.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; a declaration for income not taxed at source is due by 1 November 2026 for 2025, and from 2027 between 2 March and 1 July of the following year.

sources.said: Individuals who receive income that has not been subject to Armenian tax at source are required to file a personal tax declaration by 1 November 2026 for the calendar year 2025. Starting from 2027, the filing period shall be from 2 March to 1 July of the following year.

figures.finding: An employee born after 1 January 1974 pays a funded pension contribution of 5% of monthly gross pay under AMD 500,000, or 10% of pay (capped at AMD 1,125,000) less AMD 25,000 above that (at most AMD 87,500); from 25 December 2025 a citizen earning over AMD 200,000 pays a health contribution of AMD 4,800 (to AMD 500,000) or 10,800 a month. An entrepreneur pays 5% of income to AMD 6 million a year, or 10% less AMD 300,000 above.
figures.applies: Employees and individual entrepreneurs born after 1 January 1974.

sources.said: 5% of the monthly gross salary if it is less than AMD 500,000. 10% of the monthly gross salary (but not more than the maximum threshold) minus AMD 25,000 if the monthly gross salary is more than AMD 500,000 (capped at AMD 87,500).
For a gross salary up to AMD 500,000, the contribution is AMD 4,800. For a gross salary exceeding AMD 500,001, the contribution is AMD 10,800.

An entrepreneur whose basic annual income does not exceed AMD 6 million should make monthly social payment in the amount of 5% of the gross income. If the annual gross income of an individual entrepreneur exceeds AMD 6 million, the payment in the amount of the difference of 10% of the income and AMD 300,000 should be withheld.

figures.finding: A non-resident's income for services from Armenian sources (a performer's or writer's fee) bears a 20% withholding; royalties paid to non-residents bear 10%.

sources.said: Other income (from services) received from Armenian sources is subject to WHT at the rate of 20%.
Interests, royalties, income from the lease of property, and capital gains (except capital gains from the sale of securities) are subject to WHT at the rate of 10%,

figures.finding: The standard VAT rate is 20%; a small business under AMD 115 million of prior-year income may use the turnover tax instead of VAT.
figures.applies: Turnover tax (Tax Code Article 258) replaces VAT for an individual entrepreneur who elects it: 10% on income from other activity (a freelance screen worker's services) and 10% on rental, interest and royalty.

sources.said: The standard rate of VAT is 20%.
The turnover tax ( see below ) generally replaces VAT obligations for SMEs. One of the requirements is that the taxpayer must not cross the income threshold of AMD 115 million for the previous year.
